title: Strawberry Tree: Old Arbutus Trees You Can Visit
meta_description: Madrid put one on its coat of arms with a bear reaching into the branches. Four strawberry trees mapped, one of them 16 metres tall.
intro: Madrid put one of these on its coat of arms, a bear reaching up into the branches, and the tree on the Plaza de la Lealtad is the closest thing the city has to the original. The species is normally a shrub you can see over the top of, which makes the one on Via alla Rocca in Bergamo peculiar: 16 metres tall, with a trunk 355 centimetres around. Autumn is the moment to go. Arbutus unedo flowers and ripens fruit at the same time, so a single branch carries white bells and red fruit at once, the fruit being last year's flowers finally finishing their year. Florence's grows in the Giardino dell'Iris. The fourth stands on a wine estate above Nice at the Chateau de Cremat, whose owners kept rebuilding the same hillside into grander versions of itself.
